effects.description: If your opponent has a Character with 8000 base power or more, give this card in your hand -3 cost.
conditions: Your opponent has at least 1 Character with base power 8000 or more
This card is in your hand
steps: Reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 3
notes: This effect automatically applies while the condition (opponent having a Character with 8000 base power or more) is true

effects.description: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type or is [Uta], your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
Your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type or is [Uta]
steps: Your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
